scope: Audit every retained solid, saved placement, native expression/control, registry and scalar metadata against the released AL CAD. Manufacturing blanks are separately compared. No physical fit, strength, retention or flight qualification.
intentional_changes: Four bought bearing spacers removed. Four bearings move 0.5 mm outboard within unchanged output stubs. Frame/coupon use two integral square 1.5 mm outer-ring hooks per bearing, 0.2 mm nominal endplay, 5.6 mm shield opening and explicit 0.4 mm tool-held release. Remaining complete circumferential guide is 2.1 mm nominal/1.9 mm at inward limit; fixed top/bottom sectors retain full-width guidance. Carrier/frame axial stops remain independent of bearing capture.

Supplied X06 horns replace the separately purchased aluminium horn specification. Actual horn outline/material/holes remain unmeasured. Print two undrilled adapter blanks; prepare matching faces and two holes with a temporary centring jig, preserve original spline and OEM screw, then physically qualify runout and bidirectional torque. X8/X12 mm holes and displayed horn are illustrative prepared geometry only. The bench jig is the fourth fit/preparation print and is not installed.

Each horn gains a second M1.6 bolt/nut pair. Generic kit Phillips screw envelopes replace DIN84 assumptions. Keep M2x6 radial clamps, clock them and the input D-flat toward negative Z and move clamp centre 0.4 mm gearward to preserve walls and wiring reserves. Two R2.05 bridge-edge service scallops leave 1.95 mm nominal side ligaments and permit the Far-then-Near disassembly route.

Selected nominal-3mm stock becomes seller-claimed 304 stainless. Cut lengths remain 24/14/18 mm; output bearing journals remain round. User defers precision-stock replacement until actual fit. Supplied-horn mass is explicitly unknown and excluded from numerical subtotals rather than assigned aluminium density.

Rail, electronics, optical mount, output carrier shapes, gear pair/positions, independent 3:1 bounded motion and native limits remain unchanged. A 25-percent annular-area lower bound proves carrier-stop contact for every rotation despite the new release pockets; actual PA12 recovery, friction, creep and force remain unqualified.
